title: The exercise page's 'last time' test checks a helper the page no longer uses
what: The only test of the last-time line on an exercise page checks a helper that no screen calls any more. It also expects warm-ups left out, while the journey says the Previous card shows them. The real Previous card has no test.
expected: The test checks the Previous card the page really draws, warm-ups included as the journey says, or the unused helper and its test go.
fix_line: Point the test at the Previous card the page shows, and drop the unused helper

title: Adding your own photo or video to an exercise is never tested
what: No test opens the 'Add your photo or video' sheet, adds, changes or removes a photo, or sees the 30-second, too-large or camera-refused messages. Nothing checks the promise that the file stays on this phone, or what shows after a restore on a new phone.
expected: Tests add, change and remove a photo and a video, see each refusal message, and check the file never leaves the phone or is said to be backed up.
fix_line: Add a phone test that adds, changes and removes a photo and a video, with the refusals

title: Badges are never tested after a workout is deleted, or with help weight on an assisted lift
what: The badge tests feed the rules ready-made sets. No test deletes the workout that earned a badge, and none checks that the help weight on an assisted pull-up is kept out of the 100 kg badge.
expected: A test deletes the earning workout and sees the badge go back to Still to earn with the best so far, and an assisted lift never counts toward a weight badge.
fix_line: Add badge tests that read real saved workouts, delete one, and log an assisted lift

title: Logging a past workout while one is open is never tested
what: The Calendar asks what to do with an open workout before logging a past one, offering 'Discard it and log the past one'. No test opens the Calendar with a workout open, so nothing proves the open workout is never thrown away without asking.
expected: A test starts a workout, logs a past one from the Calendar, and sees the question with a way to resume.
fix_line: Add a phone test that logs a past workout while one is open

title: A broken photo in Share before and after, and the share copies left behind, are never tested
what: No test makes one photo fail to open and checks the 'Couldn't open one of these photos' line, and none checks the share-sized copies are cleared when the sheet closes.
expected: A test with a missing photo file sees the message and no blank picture; another closes the sheet and finds no copies left.
fix_line: Add tests for a missing photo file and for the copies being cleared

title: The lighter-weight offer for a stuck lift is never tested
what: A member stuck at the same weight for 4 workouts should be offered a lighter weight and choose. The only stuck-lift test counts stuck lifts in a plan; none checks the offer, that the weight is never dropped without asking, or that it stops after the member beats it.
expected: A test logs 4 stuck workouts, sees the offer, and checks the Target goes back to normal after a beaten weight.
fix_line: Add a test of the stuck-lift offer and the return to the normal rule

title: The coach's numbers after a failed read are never tested
what: When the weekly kg read fails once, older numbers should stand in and the next read should try again. No test makes a read fail, so nothing checks there is no crash, no empty answer, and no stand-in kept as fresh.
expected: A test fails one read and sees the older numbers, then a fresh read on the next try.
fix_line: Add a test that fails one read and checks the next read is fresh

title: The exercise page of a timed or distance exercise is never tested
what: No test opens Plank or Treadmill on its exercise page. Nothing checks Previous shows times or distances, Best is the longest or farthest, or the total uses the exercise's own distance unit.
expected: A test opens a timed and a distance exercise and checks Previous, Best and the total in the right units.
fix_line: Add exercise page tests for a timed and a distance exercise

title: The Ask an AI text is never tested for leaving out warm-ups and old workouts
what: The text tests start from workouts already picked. The part that reads the member's workouts, keeps the last 4 weeks and drops warm-ups has no test, so a warm-up best set or a 2-month-old workout could reach the shared text unseen.
expected: A test saves warm-ups and a workout older than 28 days and checks neither is in the text.
fix_line: Add a test of the workout reading behind the Ask an AI text
